snippet.title: Kittycat Couture - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Kittycat Couture is a fantasy dressup game about making outfits for cats. Style island residents, discover new designers, and fill your closet in this cozy game about appreciating fashion!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3441310/Kittycat_Couture/
